note: UPDATED 2026-08-26: vimeo support has since landed in downloaders/vimeo.py (dl_wm commit c760633, 'Add Vimeo downloader support, switch Instagram to instaloader sessions') — vendor_router.py now detects player.vimeo.com/vimeo.com and call_router.py/call_download.py dispatch these directly, no manual handling needed. This superseded the original note here (vimeo was unsupported when this file was first written on 2026-08-25). Confirmed working end-to-end for the 6 videos below: metadata/vimeo__<id>.json + metadata/raw/vimeo__<id>/ + outputs/2026-08-25/vimeo__<id>/ (download, watermark, whisper transcript, srt) all exist for each. Requires conf/app_config.json's vimeo_download.impersonate ('chrome', via curl_cffi — plain yt-dlp gets HTTP 401 on the player config endpoint regardless of Referer) and vimeo_download.referer (currently 'https://tbfrescue.org/recent-rescue-updates/').

videos.note: UPDATED 2026-08-27: fetched successfully via bin/call_router.py, full pipeline complete. Different source page than the other 6 (in-the-news, not recent-rescue-updates) — the referer-mismatch risk noted below (conf/app_config.json's vimeo_download.referer is hardcoded to the recent-rescue-updates URL) turned out not to block the fetch; whether that's because Vimeo's referer check is origin-level or something else changed was not root-caused, just confirmed working end-to-end. Outputs: metadata/vimeo__1109501243.json + metadata/raw/vimeo__1109501243/1109501243.raw.json.gz + outputs/2026-08-26/vimeo__1109501243/ (vimeo__1109501243.mp4, _watermarked.mp4, .whisper.json, .srt, .txt, .manifest.json — manifest created_at 2026-08-27T04:31:34Z) all exist. Per John's explicit instruction (2026-08-26), this was deliberately left un-fetched at staging time — staged for him to run through bin/call_router.py himself rather than fetched directly by Claude; he has since run it. See tbfrescue-mirror/findings/2026-08-26-in-the-news-video.md for discovery detail, tbfrescue-mirror/findings/2026-08-26-staging-log.md for the staging step-by-step, and tbfrescue-mirror/findings/2026-08-27-fetch-confirmed.md for the fetch confirmation.
